endpointDriver: Experimental stationary-noise detector endpoint schedules the existing Finish action; not a shipped automatic endpoint. Native gain is enabled only for this probe.
noiseCalibration: One second supplied noise-only prefix; fixed floor, 1.15 RMS ratio, 1.5 second endpoint; source speech-end labels used only for latency scoring.
method: Real-time synthetic WebAudio MediaStream → production AudioWorklet → Electron IPC → resident native Turbo → frozen locator → actual Bible preview
audioDevice: Synthetic loopback replaces getUserMedia device only; no ASR or navigation mocks
omissions: Physical microphone, room acoustics, human-labelled recordings, Windows, packaged native distribution
clock: Source AudioContext output timestamp maps the last nonzero fixture sample to renderer performance time; independently compare captured last nonzero sample
endpoint: 1500 ms stationary-noise endpoint, entire retained PCM; driver clicks Finish at detected endpoint
data: Only Bible content transport is replaced with the fixed local CUV fixture; no speech handler is replaced
